exposure: Physiological-based cord clamping (PBCC) using a new purpose-built resuscitation table (Concord)
cohort: The study included 37 preterm infants born below 35 weeks' gestational age, with a mean gestational age of 30.9 weeks and mean birth weight of 1580g.
finding: Physiological-based cord clamping (PBCC) in preterm infants using the Concord resuscitation table is feasible, with stable heart rate and quickly increasing oxygen saturation with low oxygen supply.
followup_time: Observations up to 5 minutes after birth
